description: This file provides utility functions for writing generated output files and reporting them via CLI, primarily involved in build/post-build steps for managing file outputs.

methods.name: writeGeneratedOutput
methods.description: Writes output if it has changed, based on provided parameters, and returns information about the operation.

methods.name: reportGeneratedOutputCli
methods.description: Reports the status of generated output via CLI, including handling '--check' mode and updating process exit code.
